text:
lia-support: FYI - multiple customers reporting sudden spike in 5xx and timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-west-2 (SFO edge). Seeing both 502 gateway and proxy 504s, plus a few auth retry errors. Starting triage.
omar_neteng: I see BGP update churn to provider-A from sfo-edge-02 at 02:58-03:16 UTC, and corresponding TCP retransmit bursts on our egress interfaces.
emily_sre: do we have sample request/response logs? any patterns with model shards or KV cache misses?
lia-support: sample from customer (redacted token) included:
lia-support: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"health"}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -v``` 
lia-support: logs show proxied 502s and intermittent `AUTH_RETRY` during the spike window.
ben_oncall: sFlow shows TX microbursts and queue drops on sfo-edge-02 around 03:00 UTC. Retransmit rate climbed ~130% then fell after 03:22 when a routing tweak was made.
nora_prod: customers are getting escalations. One customer asked for immediate region failover; another insists on staying in us-west. Need a quick decision and messaging.
emily_sre: quick hypothesis: provider-A BGP instability -> packet loss/asymmetry -> increased tail latency. That amplifies our cross-AZ fanout tail (KV cache misses -> many backend calls) and leads to gateway timeouts and some auth retries as proxy reconnects.
omar_neteng: Engaged provider-A NOC. I've temporarily adjusted local-pref to prefer provider-B for the affected prefixes to pull traffic off the flaky path. Monitoring now.
opsbot: incident created: INC-3310009999 severity=P2 owners=[emily_sre,omar_neteng,ben_oncall] notify=[support,neteng,prod]
ben_oncall: after pref-change at 03:22 retransmits down ~70%, error rate for impacted keys dropped ~60%. Still trace auth retry noise for a small percentage of calls.
jane_billing: note - some customers retried aggressively and exceeded billing thresholds during the spike. Tagging billing ops for possible customer credits.
lia-support: betaapp consented to a temporary per-key region-failover to eu-west-1; acme declined and prefers primary region. Implemented at 03:30 for betaapp, warned about higher latency.
emily_sre: short-term mitigations: (1) routing failover to provider-B (done), (2) per-key region-fallback when customers request (done for one), (3) enable request-level retry damping to avoid billing storms. Medium-term: reduce cross-AZ tail amplification via faster KV cache warm path.
omar_neteng: provider-A accepted pcap and timestamps and applied fixes on their peer. They've asked us to monitor for 24h stability before closing the RCA.
ben_oncall: timeline summary: spike start ~02:58 UTC, mitigation started 03:20 UTC, region-fallback applied for consenting keys 03:30 UTC, baseline restored by ~03:50 with residual tail until 04:05.
nora_prod: customer comms sent: short note explaining we saw upstream provider routing instability, we applied failover and per-key fallbacks where requested, and we're evaluating credits. Next update in 20m.
lia-support: leaving this channel for updates. Will post final follow-up after 2h stable window. :white_check_mark:
